    scope = character # Player Character

    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = castle_01 }

                    limit = {

    effect = {

DI_tm_building_legendary_shrine_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = legendary_shrine }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = legendary_shrine
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = legendary_shrine
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5

        save_scope_as = player

                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hall_of_heroes_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hall_of_heroes_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes

                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hall_of_heroes_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_03
                }

                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }

                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_04

                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hall_of_heroes_05 }
                    }
                    if = {

DI_tm_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = church_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temple_04 } remove_building = temple_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_03 } remove_building = temple_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_02 } remove_building = temple_02 }

DI_tm_building_metro_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = metro_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = metro_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = metro_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = metro_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = metro_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = metro_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = metro_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = metro_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = metro_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = metro_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_metro_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = metro_04 } remove_building = metro_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = metro_03 } remove_building = metro_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = metro_02 } remove_building = metro_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = metro_01 } remove_building = metro_01 }
            }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                DI_remove_building_type_effect = { BUILDING = gh_walls }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_harbor_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 6
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 7
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 8
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_04
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_05 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_05
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 6 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_06 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_06
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 7 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_07 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_07
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 8 }
                        NOT = { has_building = harbor_08 }
                    }
                    add_building = harbor_08
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_ruined_district_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = ruined_district_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = ruined_district_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = ruined_district_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = ruined_district_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 00_lich_stilto_katharoteras }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 00_lich_stilto_katharoteras
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 00_lich_stilto_katharoteras
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 01_jackal_gate }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_jackal_gate
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 01_jackal_gate
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = 02_jackal_gate }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_jackal_gate
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 02_jackal_gate
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 01_pathospalace

            }
        }

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = 00_lich_tabik_betemisit } remove_building = 00_lich_tabik_betemisit }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_00_tabik_betemisit_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 00_tabik_betemisit }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 00_tabik_betemisit
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 00_tabik_betemisit
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_00_tabik_betemisit_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {

DI_tm_building_01_dihasma_xiidan_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 01_dihasma_xiidan }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_dihasma_xiidan
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 01_dihasma_xiidan
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = 02_dihasma_xiidan }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_dihasma_xiidan
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 02_dihasma_xiidan
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = 03_dihasma_xiidan }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_dihasma_xiidan
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 03_dihasma_xiidan
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = 04_dihasma_xiidan }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_dihasma_xiidan
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 04_dihasma_xiidan
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_01_dihasma_xiidan_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = 04_dihasma_xiidan } remove_building = 04_dihasma_xiidan }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = 03_dihasma_xiidan } remove_building = 03_dihasma_xiidan }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = 02_dihasma_xiidan } remove_building = 02_dihasma_xiidan }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = 01_dihasma_xiidan } remove_building = 01_dihasma_xiidan }
            }
        }
    }
}

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = 00_eternal_grove } remove_building = 00_eternal_grove }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_02_karth_tower_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 02_karth_tower }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 02_karth_tower
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 02_karth_tower
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_01_dalath_analoth_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 01_dalath_analoth }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_dalath_analoth
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 01_dalath_analoth
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = 02_dalath_analoth }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_dalath_analoth
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 02_dalath_analoth
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = 02_dalath_analoth } remove_building = 02_dalath_analoth }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = 01_dalath_analoth } remove_building = 01_dalath_analoth }

                        add_special_building_slot = 01_the_folly
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 01_the_folly

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = 01_the_pirate_kings_throne }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = 01_the_pirate_kings_throne
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = 01_the_pirate_kings_throne
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_temple_citadel_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_citadel_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_temple_citadel_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temple_citadel_04 } remove_building = temple_citadel_04 }

                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_citadel_01 } remove_building = temple_citadel_01 }
            }
